notes.title: Next Fest Demo Update! "Attack of the Wokels!"
notes.content: [p]Hey there Raygunners![/p][p][/p][p]Hope you're all having a great Steam Next Fest. I've tried out a few demos myself. It's been really cool to see what awesome games are on the horizon.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to everyone who has played the demo and wishlisted the game. I've enjoyed hearing all your feedback both praise and critique. I've listened closely to what you've been saying and there's been a common refrain involving the enemy's passivity and lack of action on the Planet Doutien. So with that in mind, I am happy to announce....[/p][p][/p][h1]The Attack of the Wokels Update![/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/b4a41fd69a5dff08eb01396810fa61a8b8be98b1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]What's New?[/h2][p][/p][h3]The Wokels Have Gone Crazy + New Enemies and Variants[/h3][p][b]The Wokels have gone crazy![/b]  I dunno what they ate but they're aggressive and want to eat your face. They will now chase you down. There's also new Wokel enemies that jump! Yikes! [i](What have I done.)[/i][/p][p][/p][p]There are also new attacks for other enemies you'll meet in the demo. New enemy placements and even some enemies that weren't part of the previous version. [b]So more variety and more action and excitement![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/d140cd5658949c413375970ddaeb755f35eeae77.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]A Brand New Ability, the Down Stab Attack[/h3][p][/p][p]To help you deal with this new Wokel threat I am pleased to introduce a new Attack. The Down Stab. Skewer your foes and get a boost up into the air as a bonus. Hmm. Could use this as a traversal.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/ca304305fd9fc99fc8a083ffac4d7a09ff633a6c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/1378bde7e7893ecdbcda50371c1a42b68dc5152a.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]In Closing[/h3][p][/p][p]Thanks again and let me know what you think about the changes. [b]You can of course post a comment here on this post or[/b] [b]join the game's Discord and come say hello![/b][/p][p][/p][p] 🌟👉[url="https://discord.gg/raygungadabout" style="button"]DISCORD LINK[/url][b] 👈🌟[/b][/p][p][/p][p]See you among the stars,[/p][p][/p][p]Marcel -dev[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Devlog #36
notes.content:
Let's take a look at the history of Raygun Gadabout's Steam Banners.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/f8e4834e49493c43a892b5de48466c057ac65df6.jpg[/img]
The Steam page went live in 2018, and this was the first banner image. The character's name is Quinn (though she might not have had a name back then).

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/c16b3c86347d2b362cd69e810edc6d323aede5b2.jpg[/img]
This is a second go at it. 2019! This pose is taken from a larger alternate image that might have been too busy? Dunno.



 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/ed3375e74347716c0753a3b346dba8f3f09c24fa.jpg[/img]
This is the alternate version. I like it. Shows the variety of weird alien baddies. But it might be a bit too busy.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/7cbd15a1b5c2229e67db2ebfc82b98f51232a7b3.png[/img]
Woah. Jump to 2021! Here we have something more action packed. Added in Quinn's buddy Winchester (or Winny for short) in the right corner. Logo was tweaked as well. This one version stuck around for quite a while. There're some modifications below.?



 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/2f223ca0bb78aa76a38d50e2c585392d1d2e1a87.png[/img]
This one might have been up for a week or so. I liked the simplicity of it and the worn-out comic look which we see in the menus and UI in game. I still like it though. 😅
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/2f223ca0bb78aa76a38d50e2c585392d1d2e1a87.png[/img]
2023. A variation of the same banner from 2021. I updated Quinn's face, but I think her head looked better at an angle in the older versions.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/44c195f73712a326717e4bcdfecc479da5e9bcc4.jpg[/img]
2023-2024. Another variation of the original from way back in 2018. Quinn has a new head. I prefer her head more angled like in the previous versions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/d13680e859f6bff45e9125a7cf1d0552a1be5f19.png[/img]
 Just for fun, this was a joke banner. Never was posted of course. The context of the joke is lost to me though. 😅


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/0bf1d72599342dc36bb41fab950790321b2da12b.png[/img] 
Here's one from 2024. This one never ended up on the Store Page but was instead used for the library art.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/bc3aaba07375f8a7e0d0ccd1d72d74c3b98446f4.png[/img] 
2024 as well. This is also a redesigned Winchester, he's cuter, not his usual screaming terrified self. 😱
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/754caa548265b8093f4e9833a712d2272c914846.jpg[/img]
2025 is here. Wow! Time flies. I have this sketch I made while doing some animation sometime last November. I thought it might be nice for.... another Banner! Omy. 

Drum roll please. 🥁🥁🥁🥁bada bada bada bada!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/01274e29671645d9ee873049d883074540fdd444.png[/img]
 
Here is it! The latest and hopefully the last. Though I admit it might be tweaked I'm happy with this one. We really get across the space adventure aspect of the game. I really like how flowy her dress is. The colours really pop. What do you think? Did I make the right choice? Thanks for reading about this little journey. It was fun. 

-Marcel

notes.title: Devlog #35
notes.content:
Hey there Raygunners,
It’s Marcel here for our monthly production update. Let’s get right to it.

[h2]Animation Updates
[/h2]

Been updating Quinn’s dodge roll animation, there’s now double the frames for double the rolling action!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/d571bfaffc7a3b5d7ea30331f8f1e5dc8acc9a13.png[/img]
What do you think of the hair animation? It was pretty fun to do!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/6d2a76fdd188170e19a0599bbb1fec289ff443db.gif[/img]


[h2]Ledge Grab/Climb
[/h2]
Created a new ledge grab mechanic to save you from some deadly falls. At the moment it is unlocked with the wall jump. I’m considering whether it might be nice to have as a starting skill. Any thoughts? Share in the comments section below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/707285da25f0b46c0df8c327726c7dd76051ed81.gif[/img]


[h1]Dynamo 3 & Playtesting
[/h1]

Took part in Dynamo 3. Devs take turns presenting their game for 5 minutes. There were around 40+ people at the show and devs representing many different countries. After words there we set up the our games for some playtesting. Got some great feedback and had a lot of fun. Can’t wait to go to the next one!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/a3a8b1d6122d68fc5e5c30aebf376f2fb169d440.jpg[/img]
Some Raygun Gadabout gameplay


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/f2e5aad5e259bbccb33ddf8b975d5bc7efe3eddf.jpg[/img]
The game rocks on the Steam Deck, solid 90FPS. Yummy!


[h2]Steam Cloud
[/h2]
Added Steam Cloud integration to the game. Now you can switch between devices and continue your adventure across the cosmos anywhere!

[h2]Other Stuff
[/h2]
The usual level design, gameplay and bug fixes. Plus some new art and animation. Check out this eyeball wall. Cool eh?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/937196fb52e75fad01063239d5df934829309c0f.gif[/img]
Creepy Eyeball Wall… ew.


[h2]That’s all for Now. Or is it?[/h2]

Stay tuned for some big news in the next couple of weeks!

–Marcel

notes.title: Raygun Gadabout ALPHA Devlog #33
notes.content:
Hi there Space Cadets!

Hope you're doing fantastic today. Glad to be back, haven't posted one of these in a while.

[h1]Hey why don't ya come join the Discord[/h1]
 In case you want to keep up with all the comings and goings related to Raygun Gadabout you should join the Official Discord. There's cool people and e-cake for one and all.
[url=https://discord.gg/raygungadabout][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/fd81adb66c269ddba832e8ad18199e6bcc1a84b6.gif[/img][/url]


[h1]Space Make-over[/h1]

Been hard at work improving the look of outer space. Space is dark and empty and terrifying and is death incarnate. What it needs is more ribbons, glowy lights and party streamers. Unfortunately, we're all out of party decorations. So, we'll have to make due with murderous space pirates and deadly smash-your-face asteroid fields, oh don't forget radiactive nebula and potentially giant space monsters.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/f5686be442f6ae9be04293fdc510a52418e77abe.gif[/img]
Check out these asteroids, don't you just wanna smash into them?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/5b89d401007af8e9a907afc7818f7436fc8cd83a.png[/img]
This space station is probably filled with agreable alien folk.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/547855a291f62b591582c5f51f5140d66915e7a8.gif[/img]
A sure fire way to pretty up space is exploding Space Pirates. So much wonderful and colourful debris!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/bbcfa1c0d86a14e43257508ba019a18bf454ccab.png[/img]
A secret station wherein horrible experiments and technological abominations are fabricated with love and care.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/041e7ce005182bb4d682d314e5697758ff53c73a.png[/img]
It may be pretty but purple air tastes really gross. Trust me.


[h1]Thanks for stopping by, why not wishlist the game?[/h1]


Hey! If you haven't wishlisted now's the time. It helps us greatly. Much appreciated. Well that's all for now Space Cadets, please stop by for the next exciting episode of errr.. Steam Event Post.

notes.title: Raygun Gadabout ALPHA Devlog #32
notes.content:
Hey there Space Cadets!

It's been a while since the last alpha update post, but rest assured we've been hard at work on [b]Raygun Gadabout[/b], filling it with all kinds of gooey-spacey goodness.

Today we're going to talk weapons. Specifically [b]Plasma Weapons[/b]! yum, ionized gas fired at high speeds. 

They are useful for clearing a path, especially when that path is blocked by vile [b]Space Pirates![/b] Other potential uses are... weeding your garden, grinding your coffee and removing pesky stains from your teeth.

We're going to look at a selection of weapons from the game. All weapons (except your trusty Raygun) use energy to fire.[i] You can find energy hidden all over the place. Also enemies can drop energy when they are defeated.[/i]

[h2]Raygun[/h2]

The Raygun, tried and true. Nice curves, doesn't use any [i]Energy[/i]. matches your outfit. Always a good fallback option for getting out of a sticky situation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/8305b966195b8ec70f9815016d79c27f1002342d.png[/img]

[h2]Laser Repeater[/h2]

Highly concentrated energy beam, can hit multiple targets. Great for crowd control. Not recommended as a pointer during your office presentations though.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/b0733b0937d6130e356affcf45fb2bd98c19d4c2.png[/img]

[h2]Blast Gun[/h2]
Slow shooter but high damage, added bonus of knocking back your foes or helping you move furniture.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/eba6b270d4b83b2b955786a04c911394dc112719.png[/img]

[h2]Heavy Plasma Repeater[/h2]
When you have [i]Energy[/i] to spare the Plasma Repeater is the way to go. High rate of fire guarantees that anything standing before you is sure to be obliterated.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/b90f1541a845b55c8410499c2cd787ed33580bc3.png[/img]


That is a quick look at some of your options when dishing out violence and causing destruction to the various baddies of the galaxy. Stay tuned in the future for more ways to bring the hurt to your foes.

See you next time Space Cadets!

notes.title: Raygun Gadabout ALPHA Devlog #31
notes.content:
Hi there Space Cadets!

I hope you are all taking care of yourselves during the difficult time.

I haven't posted an update in a while but rest assured I've been busy rolling this ball forward. I've spent a large portion of the previous months locking down the gameplay and level structure. Testing things and generally moving towards making the game feature complete with the hopes of going full steam on bugs, polish, art, etc.

Part of that has been getting a grip on the gameplay progression loop. This can be quite daunting when a game allows you multiple paths, the game has become so large that I have a hard time keeping track of everything. 

[h2]Charts and spreadsheets to the rescue!!!!! So exciting!!?!?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/594030b4d2e73f8a7625fab50bbe8d992e68cf57.jpg[/img]

This has helped me have the confidence to start locking things down, I can always refer to a doc to remember where things are and what needs to be done. I guess it's the very unsexy part of gamedev but very necessary and helpful.

[h2]What's new?[/h2]

[h3]Shield break mechanic[/h3]

Don't abuse your shield, if you hit zero energy it'll break and won't be available until it refills. You can still dodge to get out of harms way in the meantime. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/dbe8fd42a52da34b29b2ac3eed0704a4d8bbeb8f.gif[/img]

To mitigate this there are [b]Badges [/b] you can equip and your shield can be upgraded. But your best bet it to tap tap tap the button! [b]Tapping at the right time is of course how you get a PERFECT REFLECT, which causes more damage and doesn't get any ricochet effect.[/b]

[h3]New Lighting[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/fc0a8e3b158aaf14e6523e9ac8c0a5354b308f2a.jpg[/img]

The game was upgraded to Unity 2020 to take advantage of all the fancy 2D lighting effects. woo! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/80c95a693d0ecc46c50c317eec08a128964ff554.gif[/img]


Projectiles can now light up the surroundings as well as the enemies. 


The decision to port the game over to the new engine was a tough one, it did take a bunch of time to get everything working properly, the game was moving from Unity 2017! So there was a few years there... But now it's all working, shiny and glowy! I'm glad I took the chance there.

[h3]Sub weapons[/h3]

You can see in the bottom left corner the temporary UI for the new sub weapons! You can pick them up hidden in the environment or dropped by enemies, there's also a new energy/ammo drop that works with these weapons. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/b41a7822178491d5e48963595f603f946deabbbf.jpg[/img]

They are pretty powerful so you might want to save them for when you really need them. Some of the weapons have special properties, for example [b]extra damage against enemy shields and poison-type damage![/b]

[h3]Tons more stuff[/h3]

There's way too many little things to list. Suffice to see I'm pretty excited with how things are going and I'm looking forward to you getting to try it out.



[h3][b]As always you can follow more developments on [url=https://twitter.com/raygungadabout]TWITTER[/url] and be sure to join the [url=https://discord.gg/raygungadabout/]DISCORD[/url]. [b]Stop by and say hello!![/b][/b][/h3]



Here's a couple more screenshots to tide you over till next time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/24fa8241667bd6e16f380fee47c6ba053e351fa1.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/3bc25c86b86949ef79d2cbc06f57bb251940def7.jpg[/img]

[h1]Thanks for stopping by![/h1]

-Marcel

I hope January treated you well. Let’s take a quick look at [b]what is new in Raygun Gadabout.[/b]

[h1]Mechanics[/h1]
Introduced a [b]Shield Break mechanic to the game.[/b] Basically if you abuse your shield and allow it to hit zero energy it will break and you won’t be able to use it until it refills to full again. This should encourage more tapping and less spamming. There is a Badge called unbreakable shield that you can equip to avoid this.

[b]The Unbreakable Shield[/b] (not necessarily the final name for this) makes your shield umm. [i]Unbreakable… But also reduces maximum shield energy by 25%.[/i]

notes.title: Raygun Gadabout ALPHA Devlog #28
notes.content:
Hello Space Cadets,

This update is coming a bit late. Been very very busy.

December being the holidays things slowed down a tad but I’ve been focusing on greyboxing out the the last parts of the game.

What is greyboxing you might ask??? It’s the process of roughing out a level using basic shapes and often unfinished art. It’s really important for testing and allows quicker iteration. You also don’t risk wasting time prettying things up with art that you end up having to trash when your level turns out to be total cr@p.

Here’s a quick look at my process.

[h1]Designing it[/h1]
First things first. A sketch made in Photoshop. I have a list of enemies of mechanics that’ll be on a particular planet, that helps me plan things out to keep a nice variety. You wouldn’t want 3 puzzle rooms in a row right?

Here’s a couple rough level sketches.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/0a65a9c921578dd8583b7b60282a8e2ee768572b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/338f7711aa2f9561f6822f4c81c159e23f53b440.png[/img]

 

[h1]Building it[/h1]
Below is a greyboxed “room”. It’s not very pretty but it gets the job done!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/241ebd22e9efc871d2f600f2ceac048e5e5feb1c.png[/img]
 

[h1]Now Some Art[/h1]
Here’s an NPC. She’s going on an adventure. Will you join her?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/82e8d2d1ddbb07919dbf9b2a633b63ff3dc4469c.png[/img]
 

Some concept art for a planet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/651a36223ace87c9faa7e102a60fe9b85ca6b484.png[/img]
 

That’s All Folks
Stay tuned for the next update. Coming soon!

notes.title: Raygun Gadabout ALPHA Devlog #25
notes.content:
Hello Space Cadets,

Here’s a quick update for what is new in Raygun Gadabout since last time.

[h1]FY-1 Bot
[/h1]Created a helpful bot that dishes out hints and tips on how to play the game. Previous hints were triggered, how you can choose to check them out or ignore them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/3767bec56755be5f1d64b4573dfacf14a119cee9.png[/img]
 

[h1]Planet Orbits
[/h1]When you orbit a planet the camera now lowers and pulls back. This helps differentiate the view from the regular when when flying around. Less likely to get confused about not being able to fly until you leave orbit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/3577251d86bb1460bc7170750f0d88e50dfce7e8.png[/img]

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/33ccbd1b905c6b35f45054d6e005d76ab8cb34fc.png[/img]

[h1]New Enemy & Melee Improvements
[/h1]Meet Karanga. He’s a new baddie. You can’t attack him from the front but his rear is very soft and smooshy, so get behind him and blam! He also fires a projectile from his eye hole.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/f7d5747a5c86e6a314b3b0f8df46f316dbd4a91f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/c3cc8a339601342e3d0e05cbbfae79b8aaa528ae.gif[/img]

You may also notice the new “Back Crit” mechanic. Melee strikes to the back do extra damage!

I decided to slow down melee attacks as well to make them compliment the fast firing projectile combat. Melee feels heavy and more satisfying now in my opinion.

[h1]What Else?[/h1]
Lots of fixes and changes, experimenting with the level layout ahead of MIGS+MEGA in November. The demo is getting close to being complete and then I’ll be switching to bugs and art additions.

There’s a private ALPHA going on at the Raygun Gadabout Discord. PM me (Quantum Duck) if you are interested.

notes.title: Raygun Gadabout ALPHA Devlog #24
notes.content:
Hey fellow Space Cadets,

Here’s an update on what’s new since last month.


[h1]Loot Artwork[/h1]
The loot pickup system is in place and I wanted to have some artwork for the drops. These are still a work in progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/abec9ad7ca032e3c1733c894024e60ec0af4dc7a.png[/img]

Loot you pickup can be used to upgrade your Badges. Badges give you passive bonuses like having more damage output or making your shield last longer. You can combine certain loot to upgrade your badges to be more effective. [url=https://raygungadabout.wordpress.com/2019/08/07/devlog-23-new-trailer/]Last month we had an early look at the Loot Menu.[/url]


[h1]Game Events[/h1]
Because some things can be done out of order or entirely skipped I have added a Game Events system that checks the state of game progression before loading up a cutscene or even which elements of an area should be spawned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/a9fb091e3ce79f6c754fcdf3cb567f124d9f0913.png[/img]


[h1]Improvements to Dodge Roll[/h1]
Made some changes to how the dodge roll in tunnels works. It now triggers more consistently and feels a lot better. I’m hoping to add some really fun stuff with this mechanic, stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/da0355498cc23c8d6dc994facbb5661e00a09f3e.gif[/img]


[h1]Optimization[/h1]
Optimization? Exciting!

Enemies are now loaded via a trigger system, now they won’t be way off somewhere wasting CPU cycles for nothing, it’s also easier to control how the player’s initial interaction will be, making sure they are facing the right way for example.

Also particle effects will be disabled when out of view, this makes a pretty big difference in performance as particles can be pretty taxing, especially when there’s a lot of them.


[h1]MIGS+MEGA[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/32767430a8ab188f9833b0fc4ea10cbe22871baa.png[/img]

I’m getting the game ready for my first game expo in November, so there’s been a larger focus of bug fixing and some polish. I’m pretty excited, hoping to get a ton of feedback from players.


[h1]Discord[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/b2ce791b3efea3c3c2ad98ba3e51aeb3b7b38e85.png[/img]

Come check out the [url=https://discord.gg/raygungadabout/]Raygun Gadabout Discord.[/url] Chat about this game, other games. Or whatever, or just come say hello!

That’s all for this episode, stay tuned next month.
